description: Edit a talking-head video in the ZAK style — a rounded window floating on pure black with equal air above and below it, one Didone serif line set once in the air above, and tight white two-to-four-word captions that hard-cut inside the window with no shadow of any kind. The camera never moves: no drift, no push-in, no transitions, nothing eases. Warm low-key plate. Runs at 16:9 (the studio default) or 9:16 (the aspect it was measured in). Uses HyperFrames (HTML→MP4). This is the fifth house style alongside `nextphase-long-editing` (coral dotted grid), `motiongraphics` (violet glow), `persa` (warm film grade) and `vibecode` (cobalt cut-paper). In Video Studio the style comes from the studio job; never ask.
